context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The saying seemed prophetic when Barack Obama and Pope Francis were prominent during the U.S.–Cuba rapprochement. The inspected reporting instead finds a recent joke circulating through anecdotes and news retellings.

A story about a taxi driver remembering a press conference does not supply its transcript, date or recording. The documentary gap is why the line should retain an explicit unconfirmed label rather than be offered as evidence of Castro predicting later leaders.
